_comment: Class metadata for freshness_cnn.keras (MobileNetV2, 224x224x3 RGB 0-255, 6-class softmax). Trained on the Kaggle 'Fruits fresh and rotten for classification' dataset (sriramr): fresh/rotten apples, bananas, oranges, in Keras alphabetical folder order. Applied as a GENERAL fresh-vs-rotten estimator for ANY edible item by collapsing the 6 classes into two groups via 'is_fresh'. The final visual score BLENDS the CNN fresh/rotten score with the platform's measured colour/texture (CV) score: final = cnn_blend_weight*cnn + (1-cnn_blend_weight)*cv. This keeps the CNN in the loop while making the predicted value track the actual look of each item (set cnn_blend_weight=1.0 for pure CNN, 0.0 for pure CV). NOTE: the model only saw three fruits, so on non-fruit foods the CNN half is an approximate visual cue. Edit and POST /api/v1/admin/system/reload-models to apply.
trained_on: Kaggle: sriramr/fruits-fresh-and-rotten-for-classification (applied generally to all edible items)
